newsitem.title: UK: BFI down nine, Atlantic grain market weak.
newsitem.headline: BFI down nine, Atlantic grain market weak.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index fell nine points on Monday to1,474 as the the Atlantic grain market contiued to decline.
Brokers said Halla fixed Marina Starr for 54,000 heavy grain US Gulf to Taiwan for Feb 1/12 at $23.40 - last Thursday this business was reported fixed for split Jan/Feb loading dates at $26.00

Reports also circulated that 54,000 heavy grain USGulf to Japan for first half february had been fixed at $24.75 basis no combination but subjects were not lifted - this compared with $26.85 no combo agreed a week ago by MSK for Jan 20/25 loading.
The Caper market was quiet today and rates for handies in the Atlantic remained weak in the grain trades.
At 1300 GMT BIFFEX was 13 points down to unchanged and turnover was 22 lots.
